column6: They …… stood around her. The holy and pure divine powers befit @wDN{Ninisina}, lady of the great divine powers. Her divine powers are divine powers bestowed on her by @wDN{An}. The Great Mountain @wDN{Enlil} determined a fate for her.

Having left the temple of @wDN{Enlil}, she entered @wSN{Eridug}, the pleasant place, and took her seat in the @fsux{abzu} shrine. Her father, @wDN{Enki}, seated her upon his knees. He truly cherished @wDN{Ninisina} -- as soon as …… took a fancy to jewels of @fsux{šuba} stone, they were hung around the neck of @wDN{Ninisina}; as soon as she took a fancy to a white linen garment, he dressed the daughter of holy @wDN{An} in it. Lord @wDN{Nudimmud} determined a fate for her. @gap{unknown no. of lines missing}
She lay down with him on …… and spent time joyously with him.
